command: import json,os,pathlib,platform; root=pathlib.Path("/sys/fs/cgroup"); names=("memory.max","memory.current","cpu.max","pids.max"); print(json.dumps({"kernel":platform.release(),"machine":platform.machine(),"libc":platform.libc_ver(),"affinity":sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),"cgroup_root":{n:(root/n).read_text().strip() for n in names if (root/n).is_file()},"meminfo_selected":{k.strip():v.strip() for k,v in (s.split(":",1) for s in pathlib.Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines()) if k.strip() in ("MemTotal","MemAvailable","SwapTotal","SwapFree")}},indent=2))
